import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"

print("SHEET NAMES:", pd.ExcelFile(path).sheet_names)
print()

raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in raw.items():
    print(f"=== RAW Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

print("=== WITH HEADER ROW ===")
parsed = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)
grand = 0.0
for name, df in parsed.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print("columns:", list(df.columns))
    for col in df.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
            s = float(df[col].sum())
            print(f"  sum of column {col!r} = {s}")
            grand += s
    print()
print(f"GRAND TOTAL (sum of all numeric columns across all sheets): {grand}")

import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "budget.xlsx"
NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
RNS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"

def local(tag):
    return tag.split('}')[-1]

def col_to_idx(col):
    idx = 0
    for ch in col:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return idx - 1

def colname(i):
    s = ""
    i += 1
    while i:
        i, rem = divmod(i - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + rem) + s
    return s

z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
names = z.namelist()
print("ZIP ENTRIES:")
for n in names:
    print("  ", n)
print()

shared = []
if "xl/sharedStrings.txt" in names:  # never true; keeps structure explicit
    pass
if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    for si in root:
        texts = [n.text or "" for n in si.iter() if local(n.tag) == "t"]
        shared.append("".join(texts))
print("sharedStrings count:", len(shared))
print()

rels_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
rel_map = {rel.get("Id"): rel.get("Target") for rel in rels_root}
print("rels:", rel_map)
print()

wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
grand_total = 0.0
for sheet in wb_root.iter():
    if local(sheet.tag) != "sheet":
        continue
    name = sheet.get("name")
    rid = sheet.get(RNS + "id")
    target = rel_map.get(rid, "").lstrip("/")
    if not target.startswith("xl/"):
        target = "xl/" + target
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (file: {target}) ===")
    data = {}
    if target in names:
        sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in sroot.iter():
            if local(row.tag) != "row":
                continue
            r = int(row.get("r"))
            for c in row:
                if local(c.tag) != "c":
                    continue
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                m = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", ref or "")
                if not m:
                    continue
                ci = col_to_idx(m.group(0))
                vnode = c.find(NS + "v")
                v = None
                if t == "s":
                    v = shared[int(vnode.text)] if vnode is not None else None
                elif t == "inlineStr":
                    is_ = c.find(NS + "is")
                    v = "".join(n.text or "" for n in is_.iter() if local(n.tag) == "t") if is_ is not None else None
                elif t == "str":
                    v = vnode.text if vnode is not None else None
                elif t == "b":
                    v = (vnode.text == "1") if vnode is not None else None
                else:
                    v = vnode.text if vnode is not None else None
                data[(r, ci)] = v

    max_r = max((k[0] for k in data), default=0)
    max_c = max((k[1] for k in data), default=0)
    print(" | ".join(["row"] + [colname(c) for c in range(max_c + 1)]))
    for rr in range(1, max_r + 1):
        print(" | ".join([str(rr)] + [str(data.get((rr, cc), "")) for cc in range(max_c + 1)]))

    col_sums = {}
    for (rr, cc), v in data.items():
        try:
            fv = float(v)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        col_sums[cc] = col_sums.get(cc, 0.0) + fv
    sheet_total = sum(col_sums.values())
    grand_total += sheet_total
    print("Column sums:", {colname(c): round(s, 4) for c, s in sorted(col_sums.items())})
    print("Sheet total (sum of numeric cells):", round(sheet_total, 4))
    print()

print("GRAND TOTAL (sum of all numeric cells across all sheets):", round(grand_total, 4))
